table.line_regex: ^Line (?P<line_id>\d+): (?P<quantity>\S+)(?: (?P<unit>\S+))? of (?P<item_code>KM-\d{4}(?: / KM-\d{4})*) (?P<description>(?:(?! at [A-Z]{3} ).)+?)(?: at [A-Z]{3} (?P<unit_price>\S+)(?: (?P<price_basis>each|per \S+))?)?(?:, less (?P<discount_pct>\S+) discount)?(?:, delivery (?P<delivery_date>.+?))?\.$
